title: studio(automations): flow status shown by Studio disagrees with what runs — header Trigger reads flow.type, a published flow reads Status draft, unbound scheduled flows read On/active
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio → Automations, read against the server log and the published metadata of the same flows.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- *Task Due Reminder* (`schedule`) is not bound on this deployment (`OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED` unset). The list row already carries the reason as a native hover `title` ("disabled by deployment policy — package-authored scheduled work is off on this deployment …", from objectstack-ai/objectui#11281), but the visible label is still a green **On**, the canvas header reads *Status: active*, and Problems reads "No problems — this flow is structurally valid." Nothing visible without hovering says it will never run.
- A record-triggered flow's header reads *Trigger: autolaunched*: it shows `flow.type`, not the Start node's `triggerType` (`record-after-update`).
- A published flow that runs has no `status` key; the header reads *Status: draft* while the list reads *On*.
- The bar says "Off by default · review before enabling", but a new flow's toggle starts *Enabled*.

## Expected

One source of truth for state: the header shows the real trigger; published/enabled state reads the same in list and header; a flow the deployment will never run says so.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Header trigger from the Start node; one derived status used by list, header and Problems; render the unbound state visibly (e.g. a grey *Not running here* chip) from the per-flow binding the server already serves on `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18235); align the default toggle with the "off by default" promise or change the copy.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *automations flow status header trigger autolaunched status draft scheduled flow not bound*: 5 hits (0 open, 5 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11281 (closed) — closed 2026-10-01 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11305): fixed the dot TITLE for policy-unbound schedule flows; that card measured the dot text 'On' too. this card's 'unbound scheduled flows read On/active' is the residual -- verify on current main before filing; header Trigger / Status draft parts are new
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11124 (closed) — same Automations header; different defect
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: flow status header autolaunched · status draft published flow · scheduled flow not bound shown on · off by default enabled
